title: add RAG agent templates and tool-calling quickstarts, update docs site
author: Asha Patel
release_notes: Add RAG agent templates and tool-calling quickstarts; update docs site navigation and search indexing; include example playbooks and small runnable snippets for Python/TS SDKs.
description:
Motivation: provide first-class, production-oriented quickstarts and templates for RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) agents and tool-calling examples that map to the Redwood API and SDKs. This PR adds opinionated agent templates, a set of tool-calling examples (Python + TypeScript), and corresponding docs site pages and sidebar entries so customers can find and run the examples end-to-end.

What this PR does:
- Adds a set of RAG agent templates under examples/agents/rag-templates (retrieval pipeline + tool adapters).
- Adds tool-calling quickstarts in examples/tool-calling/{python,typescript} with minimal runnable code and readmes.
- Updates docs site content: docs/quickstarts/rag-agent.md, docs/guides/tool-calling.md and sidebar to surface the new content.
- Adds a preview docs build pipeline and small smoke test for the examples.

Checklist:
- [x] Agent templates added and tested locally with local vector store + example dataset
- [x] Python and TypeScript quickstarts included, CI smoke tests added
- [x] Docs site pages created and linked in sidebar, search indexing hooks added
- [x] Example READMEs include expected env vars and minimal run instructions
- [x] Reviewed and approved by docs and examples reviewers

Links:
- Design/requirements: Linear ENG-8214
- Preview site: https://deploy-preview.example.redwood.dev/docs/quickstarts/rag-agent

Notes: I kept the templates intentionally small (single-file examples + README) to make them easy to copy into customer repos. More advanced orchestration and deployment recipes will follow in a follow-up that integrates with the quickstarts from the redwood-examples repo.
